wylie: gzhan yang, bdag skye med par thal, de yod na, tshe 'di'i mir skye ba len pa'i tshe skye ba snga ma'i bdag nyid bzhin du skye dgos pas 'gro ba rigs drug gi gzhi mthun yod par thal ba dang, rgan po'i lus 'di bzhin du'ang ma'i mngal na yod par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro
english: We can further put it like this: Isn't it indeed the case that nothing can start from itself? Why do you say that? Because if something could start from itself, then when we take a birth into this present life as a human, we would have to take birth as an embodiment of all our past lives as well. And this means that we would have to be a single person who exhibited all six different forms of birth at once. Moreover, our body would have to exist within our mother's womb holding the same appearance as it does now, when we are older.
